change.title: Add P3-A pure Skill inspection plan contract
change.summary: Adds a shared-crate deterministic, deny-unknown-fields SkillPlanV1 builder and validator over InspectionReportV1. The v1 schema freezes tagged exact GitHub and local opened-archive source identities, typed target binding, local name, component degradation/reasons/tools, and ordered exact package/OPERON effect subject/expected/verifier/rollback states. The P3-A builder hard-rejects non-default inspection effects and any provenance other than caller-asserted-unverified, then yields only a non-consumable content-addressed inspect_only identity with unbound target and zero effects. Confirmable is schema-only for later exact resolver/coordinator slices: its invocation ID is digest-bound, and it requires exact source/target, expiry, reentry, explicit total selection, and closed not-run effect tuples. No Gateway, Tauri, Agent, filesystem, ledger, mailbox, Science, OPERON, process, network, or credential caller is added; the v1 bridge schema and behavior stay unchanged.

basis: P3-A only adds pure in-memory plan serialization, digest, validation, summary, and source tests
current caller_asserted_unverified inspection reports are explicitly inspect_only with an unbound target, a non-consumable content-addressed identity, and zero effects
the contract has no product caller and cannot stage, confirm, apply, write a ledger, mutate a package, or attach Science OPERON
source-gate Rust fixtures allocate isolated dynamic proxy and Science ports instead of probing the installed product defaults
focused tests cover GitHub/local schema, exact package/OPERON values, report closure, sealed confirmable round-trips, invocation tamper, selection, tuple matrix, redaction, and no caller
the existing v1 bridge schema and user-visible behavior remain unchanged
